name: RC-B10-0106/2025 – § 10 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text: 10. Emphasises that respect for fundamental rights is vital to the EU’s visa liberalisation benchmarks; reiterates its call on the Commission and the Council to review Georgia’s visa-free status, with the possibility of suspension if it is considered that EU standards on democratic governance and freedoms are not being upheld; notes that the potential suspension of the visa liberalisation agreement would primarily harm the people of Georgia;
